NEAR-COLLISION HANDLED. Row 635 in this same batch is 'Dr. Ravi Raju', a CARDIOLOGIST at CARE Hospitals Nampally - a DIFFERENT person with an overlapping name. They were researched in separate query sets and separated on three independent discriminators: (1) distinct official CARE per-doctor URLs - /doctor/hyderabad/hitec-city/ravi-raju-chigullapally-cardio-thoracic-vascular-surgeon for this row vs /doctor/hyderabad/nampally/ravi-raju-heart-specialist for row 635; (2) different branch segments (hitec-city vs nampally); (3) different specialties and training - DNB Cardiothoracic and Vascular Surgery (National Board of Examinations, 2017) after MBBS from Kamineni Institute of Medical Sciences, Narketpally (2012) here, versus MD Internal Medicine + FACC after Kakatiya Medical College and Osmania there. The distinctive surname Chigullapally is the decisive signal and appears on every source used for this row. No contact, profile or credential was carried between the two rows.

Band High: TWO independent official hospital sources agree - carehospitals.com (name + 'Best Cardiothoracic Vascular Surgeon' + HITEC City branch + Hyderabad, matching the brief exactly) and medicoverhospitals.in (same name, same CTVS specialty, same HITEC City location, with DNB/MBBS detail). These are separate hospital groups, so they are genuinely independent. Corroborated further by Practo, MediBuddy, Skedoc and Telangana Today press coverage. Name appears in two spellings across sources - 'Ravi Raju Chigullapally' (CARE, MediBuddy) and 'Raviraju Chigullapally' (Medicover, Practo, Skedoc); same person, confirmed by identical specialty, city and HITEC City location. Experience is stated inconsistently in public text (Medicover/Practo say 12 years, CARE-sourced summaries say over 14 years) - recorded as a range and flagged. No published direct email, mobile or dedicated clinic line surfaced; those fields are blank rather than guessed.
